turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen's essay. Why is there a zero?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk through the version history.
Version history of what, exactly? I haven't seen anything yet.
612 words in one edit at 11:52 PM, then 794 more at 11:58 PM.
I'm writing those times down. Who decided on the zero, and why did nobody call me before it went in, under 4.2?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record; the fair outcome would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on file under procedure 4.4, so this is not there yet.
What moved her: Nothing did, because the times you gave had no date and nothing she could check against Owen's essay or his other work.
What cost ground: You went straight to the evidence without owning that the zero went in before anyone called her, so she took the meeting to procedure.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your times near midnight came close to that night, though you never said which date they belonged to, and that proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open with one sentence owning that the zero was entered before you called her, then give the date alongside the times and let her check the history herself.
Redo the debrief as a table please.
